I'm very excited for this!  One Deck Dungeon is one of my favorite new games of the last year and a fantastic solitaire game. My only gripe with it is the bookkeeping aspect, so having a digital implemenation of it will be most excellent.

posts.name: darkroydante
posts.cooked:
The game is absolutely a blast to play. It very much has a rogue-like feel. It's accessible, but a more experienced player will know what to look for in terms of skills that combo well together, and can create some really amazing builds. And then you still get brutally murdered when you roll 1's against a Phantom. 

I can't wait to see John and Jeremy playing this on Stream. Also looking forward to the dev streams!

Out of curiosity I just Googled for the physical game and it's out of stock at Games Lore and over a hundred quid(!?) on Amazon :O. So I'm guessing it's been around long enough to go out of print or something, because wow.
